title: Game runtime status
description: B1, status up: what a game runtime reports to the control plane's status listener. World truth comes from the plugin's count of the loaded world's objects, not from container health.

generation.description: The generation the runtime is running.

state.description: installing: downloading SteamCMD or the server. loading: launched, the world not yet reported. running: the world loaded. unverified: launched, but the plugin has not reported the world. held: stopped before its first autosave because the world loaded empty although a save existed; the container stays up.

reason.description: Why the runtime is held or unverified.

objects.description: The loaded world's object count, as the plugin last reported it.

players.description: Players connected, as the plugin last reported it.
